name: Ryu Ji-hye
source:
A second year in Yo-han high school. Ji-hye's Korean father worked in the Korean embassy in Japan where he met her Japanese mother. She grew up in Japan before moving to Korea. She treasures the name “Ryu Ji-hye” that her father has given her but she is more familiar with and prefers the name “Yanagi Chie” that her mother used to call her with. Because of her family upbringing, she is lady-like and immediately became popular with the boys when she transferred over. She has great talent in vocal singing.

[From [url=http://visualnovel.wordpress.com/2008/06/28/lost-number-heroines/]Visualnovel's Weblog[/url]]
